Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring that military funeral honors be available to all eligible veterans.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to military funerals; adding a new section tochapter 72.36 RCW; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that the service andsacrifices of our veterans and their families have ensured the securityand way of life for this state and for this nation. The legislaturefurther finds that the state has an obligation to help ensure that allveterans have a proper burial service. However, the legislature alsofinds that there has been significant difficulty providing militaryhonors for veterans buried in private cemeteries. It is the intent ofthe legislature to help provide for the performance of military honorsat all funeral services for veterans.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 72.36 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The department shall ensure that provision is made for all eligibleveterans buried in Washington state to receive military funeral honors.The department is authorized to implement this section through p. 1 SB 6125interagency contracts with the Washington military department or byother appropriate means.
